deadline.value: Funding deadline: applications must be received before Jan 18, 2027 (i.e. by Jan 17) for full consideration for UKRI, University of Bristol or School of Physics funding; apply as soon as possible after the cycle opens in October. Later applications are not considered once the programme is full.
deadline.quote: To receive full consideration for UKRI, University of Bristol or School of Physics funding, applications should be submitted as soon as possible after the start of the admissions cycle in October but must be received before 18 January 2027. | We are not able to consider applications submitted after the programme is full.

app_fee.value: Not stated on the page checked

fee_waiver.value: Not stated on the page checked

toefl_min.value: English profile F. TOEFL iBT tests from Jan 21, 2026: 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills; tests up to Jan 20, 2026: 83 overall (R20, L21, S21, W20 or R20, L20, S23, W20). IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with listening or speaking 6.5 and no score below 6.0
toefl_min.quote: For tests taken up to 20 January 2026: 83 overall with either R20, L21, S21 and W20, or R20, L20, S23 and W20 | For tests taken from 21 January 2026 onwards: 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills | 6.0 overall with either listening or speaking at 6.5, with no score below 6.0

also.quote: If English is not your first language, you will need to reach the requirements outlined in our profile level F.

english_waiver.value: A degree from any country counts if it was fully taught and examined in English, shown by an official Medium of Instruction (MOI) letter from the awarding institution. It must have been awarded no more than 7 years before the start, and the University may still ask for more evidence.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants with a university-level qualification listed above, when fully taught and examined in English (not including Study Abroad years) in any country, may also meet the University's English language requirements. This must be evidenced by means of an official Medium of Instruction (MOI) letter from the awarding institution, confirming that English is the medium of teaching and examination. | In all cases, qualifications must have been awarded no more than seven years prior to the start of the degree programme.

supervisor.value: Encouraged to contact the research theme's academic lead or a potential supervisor informally before applying; if you have already contacted one, name them on the form
supervisor.quote: For informal discussions before making an application, prospective students are encouraged to contact either the academic lead in the research theme of interest for guidance, or the potential supervisor for project discussions. | If you have already contacted a potential supervisor or are replying to a studentship advert, please indicate the potential supervisors name on the application form.

funding.value: The School's PhD scholarships are awarded competitively; it also typically receives some University of Bristol PGR Scholarships. Applicants bringing home-country, Commonwealth or other scholarships are welcomed.
funding.quote: In each academic year, the School of Physics has a number of scholarships for PhD degrees, which are awarded competitively to candidates with the highest research potential. | The School also typically receives a number of University of Bristol PGR Scholarships each year.

entry_route.value: PhD normally needs at least a 2:1 MSci (integrated master's) or a postgraduate MSc or equivalent; a first or 2:1 BSc may be considered if you can show good research potential or relevant professional experience
entry_route.quote: PhD: A minimum of an upper second-class MSci honours degree in physics, or a relevant related discipline, or a postgraduate MSc or international equivalent. We may consider applicants with a lower second-class MSci honours degree, or a first or upper second-class BSc honours degree who can demonstrate good potential for research or have relevant professional experience.

notes: The admissions statement linked from the page is still for 2026 entry (the 2027 version is due in the autumn). The University's 2025-26 application-fee policy (a PDF, not machine-checked) lists fees only for Business School and Economics taught programmes.
